description:
gf2 dispatches hot kernels to SIMD and HIP backends and parallelizes workloads. Researchers need the architecture to reason about which path a computation takes.

## Background

Permanent pages target researchers evaluating or adopting gf2 and assume technical competence. Explanatory prose is freshly authored; only independently verified code, commands, equations, identifiers and empirical data are reused from prior material. Pages state current supported behavior only.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: A page under `docs/concepts/` explains kernel dispatch, the SIMD backend, the HIP GPU backend and the parallelism model, verified against current code, manifests and tests.
- [hard] REQ-02: Its prose and structure are freshly authored; reused items from `crates/gf2-core/docs/KERNEL_OPTIMIZATION.md` and the backend crates' Rustdoc are limited to verified code, commands, equations, identifiers and data.
- [hard] REQ-03: It contains no elementary primer, historical narration, migration language, speculation, future promise, marketing language or performance figure.
- [hard] REQ-04: The page is listed in `docs/index.md`, and its links, anchors and citations resolve.
title: Write the acceleration architecture concepts page
